concrete_correction.before: Equal volumes give equal weights, so 20% and 40% solutions average to 30%.
concrete_correction.problem: Equal volumes do not imply equal masses if densities differ; the concentration basis was unspecified.
concrete_correction.after: Question explicitly specifies v/v concentration and additive volumes; 1 L at 20% v/v plus 1 L at 40% v/v contains 0.6 L solute in 2 L mixture, hence 30% v/v.
concrete_correction.mass_counterexample: 1 L of 20% w/w solution with mass 1 kg and 1 L of 40% w/w solution with mass 2 kg give (0.2+0.8)/(1+2)=33 1/3% w/w, not 30%.
